name: phone_removed_notify

metadata.description: Security notification sent to the account's email address when a verified phone number is removed from the account (sent by User.notify_phone_removed via user.send_template_email).
notes: `user` is a dict (user.to_dict('basic')) representing the account holder.
`phone_last4` is the last four digits of the number that was removed. The full number is never put in the email.
Sent after the save that removed the number has gone through. No token or link is included.
If the user did not remove the number, they should change their password and contact support.

subject_template: A phone number was removed from your account
text_template:
Hello{% if user.display_name %} {{ user.display_name }}{% endif %},

This is a security notice. The verified phone number ending in {{ phone_last4 }} was removed from your account.

If you made this change, no action is needed.

If you did NOT make this change, someone else may have access to your account. Change your password right away and contact support.
html_template:
A phone number was removed from your account

Hello{% if user.display_name %} {{ user.display_name }}{% endif %},

This is a security notice. The verified phone number ending in {{ phone_last4 }} was removed from your account.

Didn't make this change? Someone else may have access to your account. Change your password right away and contact support.

If you made this change, no action is needed.

Sent by Django-MOJO
